blocking_findings.detail: Exact v0.9 run_binding omits implementation_commit and adds execution_binding_merge/execution_binding_sha256, while current RunBinding requires implementation_commit and has no execution-binding fields.
Current verify_frozen_run_binding freezes packet_id SRFDI-WP10-v0.7; an otherwise science-identical diagnostic projection with packet_id SRFDI-WP10-v0.9 fails RUN_BINDING_SCIENCE_DRIFT.
Immutable v0.9 token artifact state is AUTHORIZED_UNCONSUMED_PENDING_MAIN_MERGE, while RunAuthorityStore.consume requires literal AUTHORIZED_UNCONSUMED.
Post-merge authority effect supplies AUTHORIZED_UNCONSUMED, but current CLI loads --token-json directly and has no versioned path that composes the immutable token with the authority-effect overlay.

acceptance_conditions: Exact v0.9 run binding reconstructs to ca25077124a49a02808ed0c855906456d19415df5371266ebc1e90448d022d9a without field deletion, hidden default, or substitution.
Exact G10B execution binding 2ffe195b509a22884942b50509448a5731903abb4b794c432df69a034e12fcc1 remains enforced.
Immutable token plus immutable post-merge authority effect yields one startable effective token view without mutating token identity or minting a replacement token.
Token remains unconsumed until every preflight check passes.
Frozen v0.4 scientific hashes, population, capacity, segmentation, representation, stability and source binding remain byte/logically unchanged.
Provider fetch remains DENIED and Validation remains LOCKED_UNCONSUMED.
No selector, family, semantic, publication, probability, risk, exposure or trading authority is added.
